key: populous (1989)(electronic arts)[cr vf][a2]/Populous (1989)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][a2].adf:libs/info.library:7:0594

name: dispatch_mode_routine_calls

key: populous (1989)(electronic arts)[cr vf][a2]/Populous (1989)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][a2].adf:libs/info.library:7:07AA
name: stub_empty_return

key: populous (1989)(electronic arts)[cr vf][a2]/Populous (1989)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][a2].adf:libs/info.library:7:07D2

key: populous (1989)(electronic arts)[cr vf][a2]/Populous (1989)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][a2].adf:libs/info.library:7:0814
name: stub_empty_return

key: populous (1989)(electronic arts)[cr vf][a2]/Populous (1989)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][a2].adf:libs/info.library:7:0880
name: check_three_calls_succeed
description: Calls the same indirect function up to three times, stopping at the first call that returns minus one. It returns one when all three calls succeed and zero otherwise.

key: populous (1989)(electronic arts)[cr vf][a2]/Populous (1989)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][a2].adf:libs/info.library:7:089A
name: check_two_calls_succeed
description: Calls the same indirect function twice, stopping at the first call that returns minus one. It returns one when neither call reports minus one and zero otherwise.

key: populous (1989)(electronic arts)[cr vf][a2]/Populous (1989)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][a2].adf:libs/info.library:7:08B4
name: check_call_not_failed
description: Calls an indirect function once and returns true unless it reports minus one. The result is a simple success test.

key: populous (1989)(electronic arts)[cr vf][a2]/Populous (1989)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][a2].adf:libs/info.library:7:08D0
name: stub_return_true
description: Returns one without doing anything else, so it is a constant-true stub.

key: populous (1989)(electronic arts)[cr vf][a2]/Populous (1989)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][a2].adf:libs/info.library:9:0000
name: wait_for_item_signal_mask
description: Loops indefinitely, taking an item from a structure and passing it through an unnamed routine. When no item is available it calls a library function with a single-bit mask built from a byte field, then retries.

key: populous (1989)(electronic arts)[cr vf][a2]/Populous (1989)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][a2].adf:libs/info.library:9:004E
name: stub_return_zero
description: Returns zero without doing anything else, so it is a constant-zero stub.

key: populous (1989)(electronic arts)[cr vf][a2]/Populous (1989)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][a2].adf:libs/info.library:9:0056

description: Reads a type code from a structure. Code 4 calls an unnamed routine and falls through to a common unnamed routine that returns one, code 64 forwards to another unnamed routine and returns its result, and code 512 calls an unnamed routine and returns zero.

key: populous (1989)(electronic arts)[cr vf][a2]/Populous (1989)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][a2].adf:libs/info.library:9:0082
name: call_routine_then_return
description: Calls one unnamed routine with no arguments and returns, so it is a thin wrapper around that unnamed routine.

key: populous (1989)(electronic arts)[cr vf][a2]/Populous (1989)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][a2].adf:libs/info.library:9:0090
name: call_routine_return_zero
description: Calls one unnamed routine with no arguments and then returns zero. It is a thin wrapper that always reports failure.

key: populous (1989)(electronic arts)[cr vf][a2]/Populous (1989)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][a2].adf:libs/info.library:9:009C
name: execute_two_calls
description: Calls the same unnamed routine twice in sequence and then returns one. It has no other logic.

key: populous (1989)(electronic arts)[cr vf][a2]/Populous (1989)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][a2].adf:libs/info.library:9:00B8
name: run_callback_sequence
description: Calls three unnamed routines with the same argument, adds a fourth call unless a mode byte equals one, then makes two more calls, one with a pointer taken from a field of the argument.

key: populous (1989)(electronic arts)[cr vf][a2]/Populous (1989)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][a2].adf:libs/info.library:9:0114
name: format_protection_flag_lines
description: Computes a flags value from a stored field masked to its low bits, then calls a routine four times with one flag bit each and the labels ARCHIVED, DELETEABLE, READABLE and WRITEABLE. It produces the text lines for a file protection display.

key: populous (1989)(electronic arts)[cr vf][a2]/Populous (1989)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][a2].adf:libs/info.library:9:0196
name: format_status_with_negation
description: Chooses between an empty prefix and the word NOT depending on a flag argument, then calls a routine to write a status line that combines the prefix with a supplied string and a suffix.

key: populous (1989)(electronic arts)[cr vf][a2]/Populous (1989)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][a2].adf:libs/info.library:9:01E6
name: format_text_into_stack_buffer
description: Formats a template with two string arguments and a field value into a local stack buffer, then calls two routines that use the buffer. It returns nothing.

key: populous (1989)(electronic arts)[cr vf][a2]/Populous (1989)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][a2].adf:libs/info.library:11:0000
name: measure_cstring_length
description: Counts the bytes of a null-terminated string from the start of the pointer until the zero byte and returns that count.

key: populous (1989)(electronic arts)[cr vf][a2]/Populous (1989)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][a2].adf:libs/info.library:11:000A
name: find_string_terminator_index
description: Scans forward from the second byte of a base pointer until a zero byte, then returns the index of that zero byte.

key: populous (1989)(electronic arts)[cr vf][a2]/Populous (1989)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][a2].adf:libs/info.library:11:0016
name: copy_cstring_to_buffer
description: Copies a null-terminated byte string from a source pointer to a destination pointer, including the terminating zero byte.

key: populous (1989)(electronic arts)[cr vf][a2]/Populous (1989)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][a2].adf:libs/info.library:11:0024
name: copy_fixed_byte_count
description: Copies a given number of bytes one at a time from a source pointer to a destination pointer.

key: populous (1989)(electronic arts)[cr vf][a2]/Populous (1989)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][a2].adf:libs/info.library:11:0034
name: copy_bytes_with_register_count
description: Copies bytes from a source pointer to a destination pointer in a do-while loop, using a count held in a register, so at least one byte is always copied.

key: populous (1989)(electronic arts)[cr vf][a2]/Populous (1989)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][a2].adf:libs/info.library:11:003E
name: compare_cstrings_until_mismatch
description: Advances two null-terminated strings together while their bytes match and neither reaches a zero byte, then returns whether the bytes at the stopping point are equal.

key: populous (1989)(electronic arts)[cr vf][a2]/Populous (1989)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][a2].adf:libs/info.library:11:0048
name: compare_cstrings_for_equality
description: Compares two null-terminated strings byte by byte and returns true if they are equal, stopping at the first zero byte of either string.

key: populous (1989)(electronic arts)[cr vf][a2]/Populous (1989)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][a2].adf:libs/info.library:11:0068
name: count_bytes_through_terminator
description: Walks a byte string until the first zero byte and returns the position after it, so the result counts the terminator as well as the characters.

key: populous (1989)(electronic arts)[cr vf][a2]/Populous (1989)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][a2].adf:libs/info.library:11:007C
name: run_three_library_operations
description: Calls an unnamed routine to obtain a value, then makes three library function calls on a field of a structure, passing the parameter with ten subtracted in one of them.

key: populous (1989)(electronic arts)[cr vf][a2]/Populous (1989)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][a2].adf:libs/info.library:11:00D2
name: call_string_formatter
description: Formats into a 12-byte local buffer from a global template and an argument, then passes that buffer with the other parameters to a second routine.

key: populous (1989)(electronic arts)[cr vf][a2]/Populous (1989)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][a2].adf:libs/info.library:11:011A
name: copy_pascal_string_to_cstring
description: Reads a length byte from the source, copies that many following bytes to the destination, and appends a zero terminator.

key: populous (1989)(electronic arts)[cr vf][a2]/Populous (1989)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][a2].adf:libs/info.library:11:0138
name: copy_bytes_and_terminate
description: Copies bytes from a source to a destination up to a given end index and then writes a zero terminator after the copied data.

key: populous (1989)(electronic arts)[cr vf][a2]/Populous (1989)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][a2].adf:libs/info.library:11:0154
name: initialize_request_and_send
description: Fills two structures with the supplied values and zeroed defaults, then calls unnamed routines and a library routine with an all-ones argument. It returns one unless that library call reports minus one.

key: populous (1989)(electronic arts)[cr vf][a2]/Populous (1989)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][a2].adf:libs/info.library:11:0214
name: call_library_with_field_pointer
description: Passes a pointer taken from a field of a structure to a library function and returns one.

key: populous (1989)(electronic arts)[cr vf][a2]/Populous (1989)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][a2].adf:libs/info.library:11:022E
name: run_library_setup_calls
description: Makes two library calls on a field of a structure, one with a zero argument, then a third call that passes two parameters with ten subtracted from each of them.

key: populous (1989)(electronic arts)[cr vf][a2]/Populous (1989)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][a2].adf:libs/info.library:17:0000
name: call_raw_do_fmt
description: Calls the exec formatted-output library routine through a pointer loaded from a global base, then returns. It is a thin wrapper around that library call.

key: populous (1989)(electronic arts)[cr vf][a2]/Populous (1989)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][a2].adf:libs/info.library:17:0024
name: store_byte_at_pointer
description: Writes the low byte of a register to the memory location held in an address register and returns.

key: populous (1989)(electronic arts)[cr vf][a2]/Populous (1989)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][a2].adf:libs/info.library:22:0000
name: invoke_library_entry_minus_36

key: populous (1989)(electronic arts)[cr vf][a2]/Populous (1989)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][a2].adf:libs/info.library:22:0018
name: invoke_library_entry_minus_72

name: library_entry_return_zero

key: populous (1989)(electronic arts)[cr vf][a2]/Populous (1989)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][a2].adf:libs/version.library:0:009E
name: store_two_library_pointers
description: Writes two register values into a structure at offsets 34 and 38 bytes and returns without further processing.

key: populous (1989)(electronic arts)[cr vf][a2]/Populous (1989)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][a2].adf:libs/version.library:0:00AA
name: increment_counter_and_clear_flag
description: Adds one to a 16-bit field at offset 32 of a structure and clears bit value 8 in a flag byte at offset 42.

name: finish_or_set_pending_flag
description: If the 16-bit counter at offset 32 is zero, it calls two library functions and returns the value stored at offset 38. Otherwise it sets flag bit value 8 at offset 42 and returns zero.

key: populous (1989)(electronic arts)[cr vf][a2]/Populous (1989)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][a2].adf:libs/version.library:0:00EA
name: read_value_after_library_calls
description: Reads a 32-bit value from offset 38 of a structure, calls two library functions, and returns the value it read.

key: populous (1989)(electronic arts)[cr vf][a2]/Populous (1989)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][a2].adf:libs/version.library:0:0112
name: stub_return_zero
description: Returns zero without doing anything else, so it is a constant-zero stub.

key: runtime segment $055000-$055FB0:0:0000
name: setup_graphics_and_wait_frames
description: Forbids multitasking, opens the graphics library, and configures the display with library calls and a fixed buffer address. It then loops waiting on the raster beam position and the hardware status register, and restores the saved state before releasing the lock.

key: runtime segment $055000-$055FB0:0:010C
name: close_library_and_permit
description: Restores the saved library base into the global pointer, closes that library through the exec close routine, restores a saved field at offset 50 of the base, and re-enables multitasking with the exec permit routine.

key: runtime segment $055000-$055FB0:0:065E
name: reset_tick_handler_state
description: Backs up the active per-tick handler pointer, clears the active pointer, clears a flag and a counter, and points two text pointers at a shared buffer.

key: runtime segment $055000-$055FB0:0:0696
name: advance_text_tick_timer
description: Runs once per tick. When a delay counter is zero it advances a position counter, by two when a flag is set. At ten it reads characters from a text buffer until a zero byte, setting the flag for an ampersand and a delay of 167 for byte value 167.

key: runtime segment $055000-$055FB0:0:073A
name: shift_and_copy_bit_columns
description: Copies the high bit of six source bytes into destination rows with a stride of 88 bytes, ORs in a second bit from each source byte, and then shifts a table of six 16-bit words left by one bit, repeated per count.

key: runtime segment $055000-$055FB0:0:07C6
name: copy_six_bytes_with_stride
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then copies six bytes from the source pointer into a table with a stride of 44 bytes.

key: runtime segment $055000-$055FB0:0:07E2
name: match_byte_in_table
description: Compares the byte at a text pointer with a current byte and steps through a table of entries spaced eight bytes apart until a zero entry, returning early on a match.

key: runtime segment $055000-$055FB0:0:0816
name: invoke_library_entry_minus_396
description: Calls a library function through a pointer loaded from a global base at an offset of minus 396 bytes, then returns. It is a thin library stub.

key: runtime segment $055000-$055FB0:0:0B22
name: clear_block_and_copy_rows
description: Clears a block of longwords, then copies a row of bytes into rows spaced 44 bytes apart from a source buffer, advancing through a cycling pointer table.

key: runtime segment $055000-$055FB0:0:0B9A
name: copy_table_until_sentinel
description: Copies longword entries from a source table to a destination table until the next source entry equals 65535, then writes a saved value after the last copied entry.

key: runtime segment $055000-$055FB0:0:0E76
name: copy_table_until_sentinel
description: Copies longword entries from a source table to a destination table until the next source entry equals 65535, then writes a saved value after the last copied entry.

key: runtime segment $055000-$055FB0:0:0E94
name: compute_row_index_code
description: Divides a stored value by 44, the row stride, and returns the quotient with 31 subtracted from its low byte.

key: runtime segment $055000-$055FB0:0:0EB6
name: interleave_source_bits_into_rows
description: Copies a block of longwords into a work area, then for each of 32 rows shifts bits from three source bytes through two 16-bit accumulators and stores two words per row in a table.

key: runtime segment $055000-$055FB0:0:0F12
name: fill_row_value_table
description: Fills 60 pairs of longwords in a table, where the first longword of each pair steps by a fixed increment per row and the second is a constant.

key: runtime segment $055000-$055FB0:0:0F38
name: copy_column_with_wrap
description: Copies 60 bytes from a source table into a destination spaced eight bytes apart, resetting the source pointer to a fixed address when the next source byte is 255, then advances a global pointer.

name: start_program_and_cleanup
description: Program entry for the main game hunk. It finds the current process, then takes either the workbench startup message or the command-line arguments, which it copies into a stack buffer with a space separator. It clears a block of globals, runs setup unnamed routines, and on exit closes the libraries it opened.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:0000
name: start_program_with_dos_lookup
description: Startup routine for the main hunk that finds the current process with exec and DOS library calls. It selects workbench or command-line startup, copies arguments, clears a block of globals, and runs setup and cleanup unnamed routines.

name: close_resources_and_reply
description: Calls an optional cleanup hook when one is set, closes library bases that were opened, then forbids multitasking and replies to a startup message before returning.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:020C
name: invoke_two_library_entries
description: Calls two library functions through pointers at fixed negative offsets from a base register and then returns. It has no other logic.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:021E
name: open_dos_library_or_cleanup
description: Opens the DOS library through a library call and returns its nonzero result. If the result is zero, it runs the same cleanup sequence of hook, library closes and message reply, then returns 100.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:0234
name: call_library_with_struct_fields
description: Passes two fields of a structure, the constant 12, and the address of another structure field to a library function, then returns.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:02AC
name: open_graphics_and_intuition
description: Opens the graphics and intuition libraries by name through a library call and stores their base pointers in global variables.

name: clear_buffer_and_set_flag

name: open_trackdisk_units
description: Opens the trackdisk device for units one to three. For any unit that fails to open, it records an error code of 12 and runs cleanup unnamed routines twice, then releases its message structures.

name: initialize_game_state_and_memory
description: Sets initial flags and game variables, then uses library calls to allocate work memory. It tries a 300000-byte allocation and, if it succeeds, releases it and requests 160000 bytes instead.

name: run_setup_and_global_call

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:06AE
name: read_pointer_chain_value

name: copy_sixteen_words

name: call_structure_routine_sequence
description: Passes the structure and an offset of 18 bytes to an unnamed routine, makes three more unnamed routine calls, one with the address of a global variable and one with no arguments, then returns.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:0754
name: call_three_routines_in_order
description: Calls an unnamed routine with the address of a global variable, then with the parameter, then an unnamed routine with no arguments, and returns.

name: initialize_object_record
description: Fills a record with self-referencing pointers, zeroes its fields and stores the argument values, allocates a 16-byte block through an unnamed routine, then fills a table of the given count with values derived from another unnamed routine result.

name: free_record_allocations

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:100C

name: step_palette_then_halt
